records.title: FIN-031 — Notice, Service, Due Process & Opportunity-to-Respond Protocol
records.summary: Internal procedural-maturity standard for notice, response, and contested adverse findings. It expressly does not create external jurisdiction.

records.title: FIN-032 — Burden of Proof, Evidentiary Weight & Standard-of-Review Engine
records.summary: Defines proposition states and evidentiary thresholds so allegations, leads, authenticated artifacts, findings, and external adjudications remain distinct.

records.title: FIN-033 — Findings of Fact, Conclusions of Law & Tribunal Decision Engine
records.summary: Structures auditable internal findings while preserving the difference between internal determinations and externally enforceable judgments.

records.title: Tribunal v1.12 — NEO-PACER Public Records Publication
records.summary: Documents opt-in publication of sanitized tribunal records, public endpoints, fingerprinting, and audited withdrawal.

records.title: NEO-PACER Public Case Registry
records.summary: Published case-registry dataset used by the NEO-PACER public interface. Entries remain research records rather than independent proof of external legal effect.

records.title: NEO-PACER Public Evidence Index
records.summary: Public evidence metadata used by NEO-PACER. Source provenance and authentication status should be reviewed before relying on any item.

records.title: NEO-PACER Title-Chain Dataset
records.summary: Public title-chain research dataset. It does not itself constitute a deed, title opinion, registry entry, or adjudication.

records.title: Nibiru Reserve System — Origin Architecture
records.summary: Technical architecture for translation and reconciliation. It expressly distinguishes message-schema conformance from banking authority or rail membership.

records.title: NEO Counter Ecosystem Checkout Gateway
records.summary: Documents the shared NEO checkout interface and supported payment-rail hints, including the boundary between display/manual modes and cryptographic settlement proof.
